name: The Shattered Necklace
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
You have found a tarnished necklace, though the tarnish belies intricate and magical craftsmanship.  The necklace has been shattered, as its setting appears to be missing three gems.  On the underside of the necklace is the faint imprint of the city seal for Ironforge.  Below the seal are three tiny, engraved letters: "TdK".

If there is anything to be gleaned from the necklace, you will need to learn about its origins.  Perhaps the seal and the initials are a start...
narrative.objectives: Search for the original creator of the shattered necklace to learn of its potential value.
narrative.offerRewardText: Yes... I am the jeweler who made this necklace. I also am not in the business of handing out information as though it were free. Information is never free, friend. If I am going to help you out, you need to help ME out first.
narrative.requestItemsText:
You've got the wrong gnome, pal! I was never there! You can't prove anything!

Wait a second... who are you? What the... where did you find this necklace at?

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 41 to 44, 18,425 XP in all.

quests.name: The Shattered Necklace
quests.objectiveText: Search for the original creator of the shattered necklace to learn of its potential value.

quests.name: Lore for a Price
quests.objectiveText: Bring five silver bars to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.

quests.name: Back to Uldaman
quests.objectiveText: Search for clues as to the current disposition of Talvash's necklace within Uldaman.

quests.name: Find the Gems
quests.objectiveText: Find the ruby, sapphire, and topaz that are scattered throughout Uldaman.

quests.name: Restoring the Necklace
quests.objectiveText: Obtain a power source from the most powerful construct you can find in Uldaman, and deliver it to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
